name: BiFi Lending idle USDT market (0x808c3ba9...) drain
era: post-merge; mempool-dumpster 2026-10-17 present (788,533 txs; 381 of 518 txs of block 26210255 and 111 of 276 of block 26210256 are in it) but neither the deploy tx nor the c0ffeebabe tx is
verdict_reason: The attacker EOA 0x7c78a049 deployed purpose-built contract 0x8c0d729d in block 26210255 (pos 333) and never sent a call to it (no tx to the contract ever; the EOA's next tx is block 26210307, nonce 1 -> 2, unrelated). c0ffeebabe's tx 0x756c6805... landed in the next block 26210256 at position 1 and emptied the market (USDT balance 170,038.086 -> 4,462.937). Position 0 is an unrelated Uniswap v4 arb. Our call-level comparison for c0ffeebabe.eth transactions is withheld by policy; the public traces can be compared by anyone.

headline_text: One block after an attacker deployed a purpose-built BiFi USDT-market drain contract, and before it was ever called, c0ffeebabe.eth's tx emptied the market (netting 165,574.51 USDT, 68.06 WETH) and paid 0.9868 ETH to the builder.
